brave-search._comment: Web/news discovery for industry, competitors, filings pages, IR pages, and source verification.

firecrawl._comment: Scrape/crawl/dynamic-page extraction for investor relations pages, transcripts, PDFs, product pages, and industry sources.

dialog-mcp._comment: Hosted third-party subreddit discovery (OAuth, sign in once via /mcp). Discovery only: collect posts through the Reddit API route; never cite Dialog output as evidence. Queries go to Dialog's servers; keep founder-private details out of them.

apify._comment: Hosted Apify MCP: run Store actors (Reddit, review sites) as capped paid fallbacks. Actor output is collected via scripts, never cited raw.

dataforseo._comment: Official DataForSEO MCP (metered per call). It reads DATAFORSEO_LOGIN and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD from the launching shell environment (export them; no env block so no secrets are templated here). Keyword volumes for the keyword map go through scripts/marketing/keyword_volume.py (capped, cost shown first); use MCP tools for ad hoc SERP/keyword questions. Demand proxy, not customer pain.

analytics-mcp._comment: Official Google Analytics MCP (googleanalytics/google-analytics-mcp), read-only: 0.7.0 exposes no write tools and hard-codes the readonly scope. Credentials come from Application Default Credentials created by the account owner with the analytics.readonly scope (see references/ad-platform-connections.md, Read connectors). Pinned to 0.7.0 (2026-07-29); 0.8.0 (2026-10-22) was under two weeks old. Enable in .claude/settings.local.json.

google-ads-mcp._comment: Official Google Ads MCP (googleads/google-ads-mcp 0.0.5, 2026-10-09): tools search (GAQL), get_resource_metadata, list_accessible_customers; no mutations. Uses ADC with the adwords scope plus Cloud-project API access; export GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID in the launching shell (no developer token is configured here). Enable in .claude/settings.local.json.

search-console-mcp._comment: saurabhsharma2u/search-console-mcp 2.1.3 (2026-09-02, tag commit ec9cf15). Read-only is enforced by the permissions.deny list in .claude/settings.json (sites_manage, sitemaps_submit/delete, indexing_submit, accounts_manage, adsense_*) plus the OAuth webmasters.readonly scope; the server itself has no read-only flag and requests the indexing scope on its own with service-account credentials, so use user OAuth only and never owner-level service-account credentials. Do not run setup with the indexing scope, never set BING_API_KEY, and do not use its GA4 engine (use analytics-mcp). Enable in .claude/settings.local.json.
